name: followrabbit
description: Cloud cost optimization for GCP. Check BigQuery SQL for cost problems and set the optimal pricing model on scheduled queries using the followrabbit CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Optimal pricing model for BigQuery scheduled queries
interface.longDescription: FollowRabbit sets the optimal compute pricing model, slot reservation or on-demand, on every BigQuery scheduled query in a GCP project. Codex drives the followrabbit CLI through recommend, confirm, apply and verify, and can revert the change.
defaultPrompt: Optimize the pricing model on my BigQuery scheduled queries.
Should my scheduled queries run on a reservation or on-demand?
Show me which scheduled queries Rabbit is managing in this project.
